## What Flores à Beira-Rio Does

Flores à Beira-Rio is a specialist studio that preserves emotionally significant flowers — wedding bouquets, christening flowers, funeral tributes, anniversary flowers — by transforming them into professionally framed pressed botanical art.

The method used is **handcrafted botanical pressing**: each petal is treated individually, pressed naturally without resin, silica gel, or synthetic chemicals, and then composed into a framed artwork using museum-grade materials designed to last decades.

The studio is based in Coimbra, Portugal, and serves clients across all of Europe. Flowers can be delivered to the atelier in person, sent by post, or collected at the event venue (subject to availability and quote).

---

## Services

### 1. Flower Preservation (Preservação de Flores)
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservacao-de-flores

The core service. Fresh flowers with emotional significance are received, pressed artisanally, composed into a botanical artwork, approved by the client before framing, and delivered as a finished framed piece.

**Suitable for:** wedding bouquets, christening flowers, birthday flowers, anniversary flowers, bereavement/funeral tributes, engagement flowers, graduation flowers, any flower with sentimental value.

**Price:** from €300
**Turnaround:** up to 6 months from receipt of flowers
**Payment:** 3 instalments — 30% deposit at booking (non-refundable), 40% on receipt of flowers, 30% before delivery

---

### 2. Wedding Bouquet Preservation (Preservação de Bouquet de Noiva)
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-bouquet-noiva

The most requested service. The bridal bouquet from a wedding is preserved into a framed pressed flower botanical art piece. Highly recommended to book well in advance, as slots during peak wedding season sell out months ahead.

**Price:** from €300 (frames available from €300 to €500+ depending on size and options)
**How to book:** Fill in the booking form at https://floresabeirario.pt/reservar-preservacao
**Flowers must arrive:** within 1–5 days of the wedding

---

### 3. Bouquet Recreation (Recriação de Bouquet)
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/recriacao

For clients whose flowers are too old or damaged to be pressed. Using photographs of the original bouquet, the studio recreates it with fresh similar flowers, then presses and frames the recreation.

**When to use:** flowers older than 5 days that cannot be preserved; dried flowers in poor condition; clients who never preserved their flowers but wish they had.

---

### 4. Framing Dried Flowers (Emoldurar Flores Já Secas)
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/emoldurar-flores-secas

Three options for flowers already dried:
1. **Frame as-is:** The dried flowers are framed in a deeper frame in their current state.
2. **Recreation:** The original bouquet is recreated with fresh flowers from photographs, then pressed and framed.
3. **Mixed combination:** Original flowers in good condition are kept; the rest are replaced with pressed replicas. The finished frame combines both.

---

### 5. Gift Voucher (Vale Presente / Cartão-Oferta)
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/vale-presente

A gift voucher allowing the recipient to choose their own preservation service. Ideal gift for brides-to-be, for anniversaries, or for anyone who has experienced a meaningful occasion with flowers.

---

### 6. Bereavement / Funeral Tribute Preservation
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-flores-luto-homenagem

Flowers from a funeral or memorial service are preserved into a framed artwork as a lasting tribute to the person who has passed.

---

### 7. Christening / Birth Flowers
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-flores-batizado-nascimento

Flowers from a christening or birth celebration preserved as a memento of the day.

---

### 8. Anniversary Flowers
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-flores-aniversario

Preservation of flowers received or used to mark a significant anniversary — silver wedding (25 years), golden wedding (50 years), or any birthday or relationship milestone.

---

### 9. Proposal / Engagement Flowers
URL: https://floresabeirario.pt/preservar-flores-pedido-casamento

Flowers from a marriage proposal preserved as a keepsake of the moment.

## The Process (Step by Step)

Full detail: https://floresabeirario.pt/como-funciona

1. **Book a date:** Complete the booking form online. A 30% non-refundable deposit confirms the reservation. Slots are limited; peak months book out in advance.
2. **Deliver the flowers:** Three options — drop off in person at the atelier in Ceira, Coimbra (free, by appointment); send by courier (fragile/urgent mail, costs at client's expense); collection at venue (subject to quote and availability). Flowers should arrive within 1–5 days of the event; the fresher they arrive, the better the result.
3. **Pressing and preservation:** Each petal is individually treated and pressed artisanally. The process takes up to 6 months and cannot be rushed without compromising quality.
4. **Composition approval:** Before framing, the studio sends a photograph of the composition for the client's approval. Nothing is sealed without the client's agreement.
5. **Framing and delivery:** The approved composition is framed with museum-grade materials and delivered by tracked courier or collected at the atelier.

**Order tracking:** Real-time status updates are available at https://status.floresabeirario.pt — clients receive a personalised link after booking.

---

## Materials and Quality

- **Glass:** UltraVue® UV70 — museum-grade, anti-reflective, UV-protective. The same glass used in museums to protect artworks. Eliminates glare and protects colours for decades.
- **Frames:** Wood, museum quality.
- **Pressing method:** 100% natural handcrafted botanical pressing. No resin (resin is a petrochemical plastic — not biodegradable, not recyclable). No silica gel. No synthetic chemicals.
- **Sustainability:** The studio's packaging bags are handmade by beneficiaries of APCC Coimbra (Associação de Paralisia Cerebral de Coimbra). Each bag is unique and reusable. The studio is committed to minimal waste and sustainable materials throughout.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**When should I book?**
As soon as you know the event date. Do not wait until the event approaches. Peak months sell out well in advance. If the event has already happened, contact the studio immediately.

**How long does it take?**
Up to 6 months from receipt of flowers to finished framed piece. The studio always tries to be faster, but the process cannot be rushed without sacrificing quality.

**Do you only preserve wedding bouquets?**
No. The studio preserves any flowers with emotional significance: wedding bouquets, christening flowers, anniversary flowers, silver and golden wedding flowers, bereavement and funeral tributes, proposal flowers, birthday flowers, graduation flowers.

**What if my flowers are already dried or more than 5 days old?**
Contact the studio immediately. If the flowers are still in reasonable condition, preservation may be possible. If not, the studio offers bouquet recreation (recreating the bouquet with fresh similar flowers from photographs) or framing of dried flowers as-is.

**Do you preserve all types of flowers?**
Yes. After years of experience and testing, the studio preserves all types of flowers.

**Do colours stay the same?**
There is always some colour change — removing moisture inevitably affects colour. Some flowers keep vibrant colours; others fade slightly (e.g., red roses become burgundy). This transformation is considered part of the natural beauty of the process.

**Can I personalise the frame?**
Yes. Clients can add elements such as bouquet ribbons, fabric from the wedding dress or veil, invitations, letters, or printed photographs.

**Why don't you use resin?**
Resin is a petrochemical plastic. It is not biodegradable, not recyclable, and its curing process releases harmful volatile compounds. Flores à Beira-Rio's approach is 100% natural and sustainable.

**Why don't you do 3D preservation?**
3D preservation requires large quantities of industrially produced silica gel with high energy consumption. Handcrafted pressing is more sustainable, more durable, and more aesthetically refined.

**How much does it cost?**
Prices start at €300 and always include professional framing with museum-grade UV-protective anti-reflective glass. Full pricing is available at https://floresabeirario.pt/opcoes-e-precos.

**How does payment work?**
Three instalments: 30% deposit at booking (non-refundable), 40% when flowers arrive, 30% before the finished frame is delivered.

**Can I track my order?**
Yes. Every client receives a personalised link to follow their order's real-time status at https://status.floresabeirario.pt.

**Do you accept flowers from outside Portugal?**
Yes, from all over Europe. Flowers are sent by international courier (fragile/urgent mail) at the sender's expense.
